references.note: third-party BGA wiki card page; cost, prerequisite, points and effect
English list page row used to cross-check the card id, name and effect text

play.alternative_cost_notes: あなたのサプライの厩ひとつ (one stable from your supply; per the BGA wiki page)

effects.notes: After the field phase of each harvest (modeled as feeding phase): exchange 1 grain + 1 fence wood from your supply for 5 food. The wiki's 1 fence is reproduced from the supply as wood:1; see unresolved.

unresolved_fields: play.cost: the wiki cost is あなたのサプライの厩ひとつ (return 1 stable from your supply); paying in stables has no established cost encoding — modeled as alternative_cost_notes with cost=null
effects.0.timing: the wiki allows the exchange after the field phase of each harvest; after_field_phase is outside the established trigger vocabulary, modeled as harvest_feeding
play.printed_points: the ledger lists 0 while the wiki info table shows no victory points; recorded as null (unverified) rather than 0

effects.0.fence_to_wood: the wiki requires giving 1 fence in the harvest exchange; the engine models fences as an unspendable construction, so the exchange is encoded as wood:1 from the player's supply while real fence payment capability is unresolved
review.notes: After the field phase of each harvest, exchange 1 grain plus 1 fence (both from your supply) for 5 food.
